details: Properness is an additional restriction. On the singleton class $\mathcal S_n$, $n\ge2$, the database-owned value proofs give $\lceil(n-1)/2\rceil\le\mathrm{psLSC}(\mathcal S_n)\le n-1$, while $\mathrm{sLSC}(\mathcal S_n)=1$ (values 1157 and 487). Therefore no universal reverse affine bound is possible. Only linear asymptotic order, not an exact psLSC formula, is used.
proof: Proper stable labeled compression adds properness to stable labeled compression. Restricting the allowed reconstruction functions cannot decrease the minimum size.
name: Proper Stable Labeled Sample Compression / Stable Labeled Sample Compression
